title: Intake Desk
summary: Check supplier deliveries against purchase orders and record shortages or damage at the receiving desk.
user: 10–100-person distributors, workshops, and small manufacturers that receive supplier deliveries against purchase orders but are not ready to implement an ERP.

evidence.quote_or_summary: A team describes smaller companies running procurement in spreadsheets/email: missed orders, lost documents, manual packing-list matching, and slow goods receipt; they say ERP alternatives were too heavy and expensive.
A current ERP issue reports that goods reception cannot load the items from a supplier order and can create only an empty reception—the precise intake step that must be dependable.

recurrence: The 2026 SMB procurement report describes repeated order, document, and warehouse intake chaos; a separate ERP issue confirms receiving is a brittle critical path rather than a solved spreadsheet replacement.
current_workaround: Email POs, print packing lists, check quantities by hand, update spreadsheets, then chase suppliers for status.
incumbents_and_gap: Odoo, Dolibarr, NetSuite, Cin7, and procure-to-pay suites are broad and setup-heavy. The gap is a one-day receiving desk that can start from CSV/email POs and create a trustworthy discrepancy record.
smallest_useful_product: Supplier PO inbox, QR/phone receiving, expected-versus-received scan/count, photo/doc attachment, discrepancy/partial-delivery workflow, and accounting/ERP CSV export. Non-goals: general ledger, warehouse management system, forecasting, or supplier marketplace.
success_measure: A pilot warehouse records 95% of deliveries on the day received and cuts time from arrival to discrepancy notification by 50%.
monetization: subscription — $149/site/month supports a workflow used by receiving staff every day and is materially cheaper than an ERP project.
constraints: Offline-capable scanning, hardware/browser compatibility, document retention, accurate unit conversion, immutable receipt audit trail, and integration import validation.
why_distinct: It starts at the receiving dock and produces evidence of exceptions, instead of competing as a full procurement or ERP platform.
